evals.prompt: Use $minimalism-audit. Audit this proposed workflow: five agents independently summarize the same PR, two agents rewrite each summary, then a final agent merges them. Reduce unnecessary complexity while preserving review quality, traceability, and safety. Return a smaller deterministic workflow with explicit artifacts and stop conditions. Text only.
evals.expected_output: A minimalism audit that removes redundant work while preserving quality, traceability, safety, explicit artifacts, and deterministic stop conditions.
expectations: The response identifies duplicated summaries and unnecessary agent stages as the waste.
The response proposes a smaller workflow with clear roles or stages.
The response preserves traceability/review quality through explicit artifacts or evidence.
The response defines deterministic stop conditions or acceptance criteria rather than optimizing tokens alone.
